Acme X1 gateway released

September 30

Connectivity

Acme announced the X1 gateway for industrial sensor networks. The gateway supports Matter and Thread alongside Ethernet and Wi-Fi. Administrators can configure local processing without relying on cloud services, and the hardware exposes a documented interface for integration with existing monitoring systems.

  • Local data processing
  • Documented integration interface

The release includes a maintenance guide and installation instructions. Availability begins in October, according to the official announcement. Pricing is described on the separate product page.
